label: Zyxel VMG4005-B50A VDSL2 35b single-line bridge modem
description: Pure VDSL2 bridge modem delivering 300 Mbit/s on a 35b single line (200 Mbit/s with 17a bonding) with ADSL2+ fallback, one RJ-11 line port and one 10/100/1000 Ethernet LAN port, transparently bridging PPPoE to the router behind it.
